'''Fero''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Human]] [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] and [[chief medical officer]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. She was stationed on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="Encounter" />
